blocks.text: The human endocrine system is the set of glands and organs that produce and secrete hormones to regulate body functions. The figure shows where the major glands lie.

blocks.alt: Grey outline of a human body with the major endocrine glands in place: pituitary below the brain, thyroid in the neck, pancreas behind the stomach (digestive tract), adrenal glands on top of the kidneys, ovaries beside the uterus and the testes. Insets: the pituitary with anterior and posterior lobes; the thyroid with parathyroid glands on its back; a kidney with the adrenal gland on top.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.1: Locations of major endocrine glands in human body (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 16.1).
